Sumi Park: hey hi redwood! i'm sumi, just started on devex today. small intro — i work on infra tooling, i'm trying to keep a sunrise journaling habit, and i've got a tiny corgi named Mochi. i brought a few jars of apricot+honey jam to the kitchen, help yourself! :wave:
Jaden Ortiz: welcome sumi!! will swing by for jam. corgi pics pls :heart_eyes:
Mikaela Ng: yay welcome!! love sunrise journaling — any quick tips? also fyi there's a casual welcome lunch at noon in the kitchen if you want to join 🍱
Harper Lin: welcome!! mochis are the best. we'll save you the green mug on the rack :coffee:
Zoe Martinez: hi sumi! quick note — we label homemade food in the fridge. leave a note with ingredients if you can. congrats and glad you're here :tada:
onboarding-bot: Hi Sumi Park — welcome to Redwood! Friendly reminder to complete Security Basics and HR paperwork by Friday. Links: <https://intranet.redwood/onboarding>
Sumi Park: thanks everyone! i'll add an ingredients note (no nuts). totally down for lunch at noon and i'll post a Mochi pic later today :camera_with_flash:
Jaden Ortiz: team walk at 3pm if you want to bring Mochi for a cameo — short loop behind the office, super low-key :dog:
Harper Lin: same — see you at lunch and maybe 3pm. also ping me if you want a desk plant recommendation :)
Zoe Martinez: officially welcome again :sparkles:
